in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Blessed by Shiva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shaunak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shaunak is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shaunaka', which means 'Blessed by Shiva'. In Hindu mythology, Shaunak is the name of a sage and a disciple of Lord Shiva. He is also known as 'Kaundinya' and 'Gautama Rishi'. Shaunak is believed to have written the epic Mahabharata and is also considered to be the teacher of the great sage Vyasa.
